breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect approach from the incomplete prompt: it replaces the uniform distributed load with its resultant (R = wL = 900 N) acting as a point load at midspan, then uses the point-load formula δ = PL³/(48EI) for the UDL contribution. The ground truth requires using the standard UDL midspan deflection formula δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) instead. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency and instead propagated the erroneous method.
